app_fee.value: The application fee is $100 for all applicants.
app_fee.quote: There is an application fee of $100.00 USD.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go to a limited number of applicants who show financial need or belong to partner organisations; request one inside the online application.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers will be granted to a limited number of applicants who can demonstrate financial need or are affiliated with organizations that have made special arrangements with our office.

gre_general.value: GRE policy is set by each department; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: Caltech does not require an English test for admission and sets no minimum TOEFL score; admitted students with limited English instruction get an evaluation at Orientation.
toefl_min.quote: There is no minimum requirement for the English proficiency exams.

ielts_min.value: No minimum IELTS band; an English test is not required for admission.
ielts_min.quote: There is no minimum requirement for the English proficiency exams.

english_waiver.value: A degree from a university where the primary language of instruction is English exempts the applicant from English proficiency evaluation, so an English-medium Indian degree should qualify.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants with a degree from a college or university whose primary instruction is in English

notes: English test is optional for all; GRE rules are per department.
